UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Stores a student user's synced workspace state including Pomodoro study stats, resume builder fields, and study notes.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

displayName.description: The display name of the student.

resumeFullName.description: Full name on the student's resume.

resumeTitle.description: Role or headline on the student's resume.

resumeSummary.description: Career objective or summary on the resume.

resumeExperience.description: Internship or work experience on the resume.

resumeProjects.description: Academic and personal projects on the resume.

resumeSkillsText.description: Comma-separated technical skills for the resume.

resumeColor.description: Hex accent color for the resume preview.

savedNotes.description: Transcribed voice notes and study notes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

SavedCalculation.title: SavedCalculation
SavedCalculation.description: A saved calculator result, grade conversion, or AI study note belonging to a specific user.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the calculation owner.

toolName.description: Name of the calculator or tool used.

details.description: Additional calculation parameters or AI study content.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

/userWorkspaces/{userId}.description: Per-user workspace document indexed by the user's Firebase Auth UID.

/savedCalculations/{calcId}.description: Saved calculator results and AI study snippets owned by users.
